origin: New deployment-specific component; reuses native ESPHome BLEClientNode and Component APIs without copying or replacing the stack.
behavior: Pair/encrypt once after successful native OPEN unless peer security already started; gate setup on authenticated remote and successful service discovery.
Read actual 2908 values serially for every 2A4D under 1812; require unique input IDs 1/3/30 and CCCDs; subscribe serially and wait for write completions before releasing native cache.
Forward raw notification bytes by discovered handle, including releases/repeats; reject unexpected control-report lengths and unknown report mappings.
Existing speaker authenticated subscriber state gates output. No stale offline key queue. Physical reports cancel pending synthetic HA releases; disconnected remote releases held keys.
A 60-second setup timeout reports missing completion instead of hanging silently; native client owns reconnection.

Remote maintenance pairing: pause only native remote client, require actual close or initially idle, remove only verified remote bond, wait exact removal completion, then resume scanning; speaker bond/CCCD untouched.

Authenticated remote notification only: exact13captured key mapping to native event and Chinese last-key text; release and held-repeat observations suppressed; raw forwarding unchanged. HA synthetic keys never enter observer.

Native receive event types use Chinese labels; English protocol_key is retained solely for captured-payload identity. Independent HA send events and text record only send_key press outcomes, including all rejected requests; no receive or release reports enter HA send history.

A submitted HA press requires notify/emit to return stack acceptance. HA busy state is established before submit, rolled back on rejection, and the original 150 ms release is scheduled before publishing success. A release failure is logged without fabricating a second press event or adding retries.
review: Independent source/API/cache/security/HA review completed. Fixed its reconnect-ready zero-release race by not overwriting physically held or active HA reports.
Added current-connection auth guard, native peer-initiated security guard, public/central role check and failed/disconnecting OPEN guard.
Remote-pair reset independently reviewed; actual CLOSE/failed OPEN evidence added so native forced-IDLE timeout cannot be mistaken for a completed disconnect.
Received-key observer reviewed; constexpr tests execute inside firmware C++ build and13mapping crosscheck matches jbl_protocol.json.
Independent review passed Chinese event lists, exact 13-code validation, source isolation, error rollback, accepted-before-history ordering and unchanged physical takeover/150 ms release behavior.
validation: verify_provenance.py checks source integrity and Python syntax.
Parent performs one coordinated C++ build, isolated remote pairing/notifications, then simultaneous speaker/remote and sleep/restart/held-key tests.

2026-10-17: 13 captured mappings, 14 Chinese receive types, 27 HA send-result types and source acceptance/rejection wiring passed verify_received_keys.py; full YAML capture check and 21-label in-memory ESPHome code generation passed. C++ static_assert covers decoding/dedup and all pre-send gate decisions in the next parent build.
limitations: Only the verified remote and speaker; no general HID mapping, output-report forwarding or additional devices.
Vendor report transport up to characteristic size is preserved, but large vendor packets and two-link MTU behavior have not been exercised. Observed button reports are 8 and 2 bytes.
50 percent passive scan duty may miss a short sleep/wake advertising window; first-key retention requires physical validation.

Submitted means at least one ESP-IDF notification call returned ESP_OK, not speaker execution or delivery acknowledgement. A later failed release is logged; no new release retry mechanism or offline event queue was added.

archive_parameterization.configuration: Speaker public MAC from required esp32_ble_server.speaker_mac; remote public MAC from linked native ble_client.mac_address. Use local secrets.yaml.
archive_parameterization.review: Independent source review passed identity/role/authentication gates, generated-array wiring and original CCCD key compatibility. See release manifest for compile status and evidence/validation-summary.json for physical validation scope.
notes: No automatic address learning or relaxed peer filtering.
CCCD identity retains the v1 lowercase MAC-based key format; matching original address preserves its preferences.
Historical review entries describe intermediate development; consolidated validation evidence is authoritative.
